instructions: Path of Building (PoE1) through PobTools. Call build_guide once first: it explains how to read a build (keystones such as Chaos Inoculation change what a "bad" number means). Every number comes from Path of Building's own calculation. The server works on ONE build in a private sandbox: load_build or new_build first, change it with the tools, read numbers with build_summary, and hand the result to the user with export_code (a share code they paste into Path of Building). Nothing is written to the user's own Path of Building folder, except a new file in Builds\AI\ when you call save_build. Use what_if to compare changes without keeping them. Names come in English (name) and Traditional Chinese (nameZh); arguments accept either. DPS depends heavily on the configuration (enemy type, charges, buffs): check get_config before trusting it. Rare items are calculated exactly as written, whether or not they could be crafted in game.

tools.name: build_guide
tools.description: Read once before judging builds: how to interpret Path of Building numbers (build intent from keystones and immunities, defence layers, configuration-dependent DPS). Works before a build is loaded.

tools.name: report_problem
tools.description: When a tool error says it was written to PobTools\logs (a PobTools bug or a broken install, not a wrong argument): build a bug report for the user with versions and the recent MCP errors, with their Windows user folder replaced by %USERPROFILE%. Show it to the user to review and paste into a GitHub issue; never post it yourself. Works even when Path of Building does not start.

tools.name: load_build
tools.description: Load a build into the sandbox from a Path of Building share code, a build URL (pobb.in, poe.ninja, pastebin...), or a file name returned by list_my_builds. Replaces the current build. Returns a summary.

source.description: Share code, URL, or Builds-relative .xml file name

tools.name: list_my_builds
tools.description: List the builds saved in the user's Path of Building (read-only copy).

tools.name: new_build
tools.description: Start an empty level-1 build for a class and optional ascendancy. Replaces the current build.

tools.name: export_code
tools.description: Export the current build as a Path of Building share code for the user to import.

tools.name: save_build
tools.description: Save a copy of the current build as a new file in the user's Path of Building Builds\AI\ folder, so they can open it there. Never overwrites: an existing name is an error. load_build accepts the returned file afterwards.

name.description: File name only (no folders); .xml is added

tools.name: build_summary
tools.description: Class, ascendancy, level, passive points, allocated keystones (with their stat lines), damage types the build is immune to (immuneTo), main skill and about 40 key numbers (life, EHP, max hits, DPS, resistances, defences, mana) of the current build.

tools.name: stat_breakdown
tools.description: Path of Building's breakdown of one number (where it comes from), as text lines. stat is a key from build_summary.stats.

tools.name: check_build
tools.description: Rule-based health check of the current build (resistances, life pool, hit chance, mana sustain, defence layers, utility skills). Returns issues with severity error/warning/info.

tools.name: scenarios
tools.description: The build's real numbers in harder situations: key numbers as configured now (current), against a Pinnacle boss (pinnacle), against an Uber Pinnacle boss (uber), and with every flask switched off (flasksOff, boss setting unchanged). Does not change the build. / 流派在實戰情境下的真實數值:現況(current)、對巔峰首領(pinnacle)、對超級巔峰首領(uber)、所有藥劑關閉(flasksOff,首領設定不變)。不會改動流派。

tools.name: audit_inflation
tools.description: Find what props up the sheet numbers: compares the build as configured (current) with a conservative baseline (Pinnacle boss, flasks off, custom modifiers cleared, every other changed configuration option back to its default), and lists the configuration options, flasks and custom modifiers that each add the most DPS / EHP on their own (contributors, largest first; a negative value means the option lowers the number; dps is the minion's for a minion skill). Bandit, pantheon and resistance penalty are the character's own choices and are left as they are. Party (teammate auras) is not audited in this version (partyAudited=false). Does not change the build. / 找出撐高面板數字的來源:比較現況(current)與保守基準(baseline:巔峰首領、藥劑全關、自訂詞綴清空、其他改過的設定還原預設),並列出單獨貢獻最多 DPS / EHP 的設定項、藥劑與自訂詞綴(contributors,由大到小;負值代表該項壓低數值;召喚物技能的 dps 取召喚物的)。盜賊任務、萬神殿與抗性懲罰屬角色本身的選擇,不列入也不還原。隊友光環(Party)此版不納入(partyAudited=false)。不會改動流派。

tools.name: build_report
tools.description: The whole analysis in one Markdown text (at most 24,000 characters): instructions for the reader, build summary, inflation audit, scenarios, issues, tree / skills / configuration / items, and tested candidates (passive nodes, support gems, anoints, top 10 each with their measured change). Slow (several minutes). Does not change the build. / 一次產生完整分析的 Markdown(上限 24,000 字元):給讀者的說明、流派摘要、去水分、多情境、問題、天賦/技能/設定/裝備,以及已試算候選(天賦、輔助寶石、塗油,各前 10 並附變化量)。耗時數分鐘。不會改動流派。

tools.name: tree_summary
tools.description: Allocated passive count, keystones, notables and jewel sockets (with the jewel in each).

tools.name: suggest_nodes
tools.description: Unallocated passives ranked by Path of Building's node power for offence or defence (slow on big builds: up to a minute). pathDist is the points needed to reach the node.

tools.name: search_nodes
tools.description: Find passive nodes by name or stat text (English or Chinese). Returns ids for allocate_nodes.

tools.name: allocate_nodes
tools.description: Allocate passive nodes by id; the shortest path to each is allocated too, as in Path of Building. A mastery needs its effect id in masteries.

tools.name: deallocate_nodes
tools.description: Deallocate passive nodes by id (nodes that depended on them are removed too, as in Path of Building).

tools.name: list_skills
tools.description: Socket groups with their gems, levels and qualities, which group is the main skill, and whether each group currently affects the build (`active`; `inactiveReason` says why not, e.g. weapon-swap slot or disabled).

tools.name: search_gems
tools.description: Find skill or support gems by part of the name (English or Chinese).

support.description: true = supports only, false = actives only

tools.name: set_skill_group
tools.description: Add a NEW socket group (omit index), or REPLACE all gems of group `index` (its old gems are lost). main=true makes it the main skill. A group socketed in an inactive slot (e.g. the weapon-swap set) does not affect the build; the result then carries a `warning`.

slot.description: Item slot the gems are socketed in, e.g. Body Armour

tools.name: rank_supports
tools.description: Support gems that can support a socket group, ranked by Path of Building's own DPS estimate for adding each one (the gem picker's 'sort by DPS'). Omit index for the main skill group. Use it to choose links, then verify the pick with what_if.

tools.name: rank_anoints
tools.description: Notables to anoint on the equipped amulet, ranked by Path of Building's Anoint dialog ('Sort by <stat>': the build recalculated with each anoint). metric is a power stat such as CombinedDPS, FullDPS, TotalEHP, Life, EnergyShield. Needs an amulet in the Amulet slot. Does not change the build.

tools.name: list_items
tools.description: Equipped items per slot, with their full item text.

tools.name: search_uniques
tools.description: Find unique items by name (English or Chinese), optionally filtered by item type (e.g. Ring, Body Armour). Returns item text usable with equip_item.

tools.name: list_bases
tools.description: Item bases (for writing rare items), filtered by name and/or type.

tools.name: equip_item
tools.description: Create an item from text (Path of Building / game copy format: 'Rarity: Rare', name, base, mod lines) and equip it, into `slot` or the first slot it fits.

tools.name: unequip_item
tools.description: Empty an item slot (slot name as in list_items).

tools.name: get_config
tools.description: Configuration options that apply to this build (enemy, charges, buffs, conditions) with current values and choices.

tools.name: set_config
tools.description: Set one configuration option by key (from get_config). Booleans for checkboxes, numbers for counts, a choice value for lists. Returns before/after (what Path of Building stored) and applied.

tools.name: what_if
tools.description: Apply a list of changes, return key numbers before/after and the difference, then restore the build exactly. Each action is {tool, arguments} with the SAME arguments that tool takes on its own: allocate_nodes / deallocate_nodes {ids:[node id integers from suggest_nodes or search_nodes]}, set_skill_group {gems:[{name, level?, quality?}], index?, slot?, main?}, equip_item {text, slot?}, unequip_item {slot}, set_config {key, value}.
